Mira: FYI vendor just flagged a split manifest on our Dedicated rack reservation for EU-dedicated-02. ETA slipping ~10 days.
Dan: which reservation? id?
Mira: reservation RSRV-8821, vendor manifest 78923-UK, says 4/6 racks delayed due to customs docs. posted screenshot in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/manifest-78923
Alejandro: can we borrow from marketplace burst pool? what's current burst capacity?
Claire: marketplace has ~2 racks free in eu-west but not profiled for Dedicated (latency/cost diff). SI partner launch still scheduled week of 2024-04-16.
Dan: timeline risk — if manifest clears +10d we miss commit SLA for the SI. finance + legal need to know potential credits. @Sam any customer-facing plan?
Sam: pinged CS. we'll propose a staged launch and offer onboarding credits. need to confirm feasibility of partial capacity (2 racks) for canary.
Mira: vendor offered to split shipments earlier but needs extra handling fees ~ $6k. ops-bot: Shipping alert logged: SHIP-78923 -> delayed -> customs paperwork hold.
Alejandro: is there an option to swap to smaller GPU chassis to fill slot? we have leftover edge racks from last trial.
Dan: switching chassis requires re-cabling and config. would add ~48h setup. better than 10d.
Claire: propose immediate action: 1) accept vendor split + handling fee for 2 racks, 2) provision 2 edge racks as stopgap, 3) notify customer and set staged rollout. Who owns ops & finance approvals?
Mira: I can approve the split fee up to $8k. @Dan please start swap plan with infra, @Alejandro confirm edge rack readiness. I'll draft the customer note with CS.
Alejandro: edge racks can be ready in 36h, need image build and kernel tweak. posting setup checklist:
```
- burn image v1.9
- kernel 5.15 + patched nccl
- network VLAN tag 2109
- test plan: perf on seq len 2048
```
Dan: I'll ping infra team and schedule config window. tagging @ops-bot for ticket creation.
ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4556 for chassis swap and SHIP-78923 follow-up.
Sam: customer OK w/ staged launch if we get canary by 2024-04-14. I'll schedule a sync with their PM.
Mira: great. let's reconvene after INFRA-4556 has updates. thanks all :thumbsup:
